title: NIGHT TERRORS
content: I have CHRONIC night terrors. I say this because I have yet to find proper treatment (I’ve even been told by a professional that there is nothing they can do) and have had them nearly EVERY SINGLE NIGHT for the last (almost) TWO years. I thrash and scream. They’re very very vivid. But does anyone else have any about very specific places that they can scout their way around like it’s nothing? Places they’ve never seen or been to before? Or places that just feel entirely dark and evil? Like you can’t quite explain it because there aren’t words that can… I’d love to share more but I gotta know if there’s more of you out there!!
